input: Our augmented reality pipeline requires camera frame latency below 5ms from sensor capture to ISP output for motion-to-photon requirements. Currently achieving 8ms. We are using MIPI CSI-2 v4.0. The ISP pipeline processes 4K at 60fps. How does MIPI CSI-2 v4.0 LRTE (Latency Reduction and Transport Efficiency) reduce the capture-to-ISP latency, and what other pipeline stages should we optimize to reach the 5ms target?
